hero.eyebrow: Finca Los Collados de San Miguel · Campo de Montiel
hero.title: La Mancha, unhurried
hero.subtitle: Eight private bungalows among holm oaks and olive groves, Manchegan cooking and open skies in the heart of Campo de Montiel.

intro.title: A quiet retreat in La Mancha
intro.text: Los Collados de San Miguel is a private estate of Mediterranean woodland in Villamanrique. Few guests, plenty of space and the unhurried pace of the countryside: slow breakfasts, afternoons by the pool or the fire, and silent nights under a clear sky.

stay.title: Bungalows designed for rest
stay.text: A double bed, a fireplace, your own porch and views over the countryside. Breakfast included, with the pool and shared lounges a few steps away.
